unauthorized: The credentials or installation key are invalid.
alreadyConfigured: An administrator already exists. Please sign in.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
invalidInput: Check your email and password (at least 12 characters, at most 1024 bytes).
requestFailed: The server is unavailable or could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
setupIntro: Create an account to manage this installation.
loginIntro: Sign in to your Open Faktura installation.
created: Administrator created. You can now sign in.
keyExplanation: It confirms your permission to create the first administrator. You only use it once; it is not a password or licence code.
keySafety: Next time, sign in with your email and password. Keep the key private.
forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Ask your installation administrator to restore access.
existingAdmin: Already have an administrator? Sign in
keyFile: For your own installation, find the key in this file:
setupFailed: Unable to check installation status. Check your connection to the server.
companyPending: You are signed in. Company setup is coming next; no company workspace is open yet.
homeIntro: Open invoicing, under your control. Your Open Faktura starts here.
development: The application is in development. Company management, contacts and invoicing are coming soon.
footer: Open Faktura / Your data. Your space.
invalidForm: Complete the required fields and check their format and length.
companyConflict: The settings changed or a request was repeated with different data. Load the current version; this will replace your unsaved changes.
companyNotFound: The company does not exist or you do not have access.
companyForbidden: Only the company owner can change settings.
companyInvalid: Check the listed fields. Complete the profile before finishing.
companiesIntro: Separate billing details for each of your businesses or activities.
noCompanies: Working for yourself? One profile with your name and address is enough. You can add another at any time if you invoice for a different entity.
numberPreview: Number preview: {{number}}. Previewing does not reserve a number.
companyReviewHint: Check your details before finishing. Invoice issuance will become available in subsequent development phases.
emptyWorkspace: Your details are ready. Invoicing is still in development; we will use this profile for your documents.
companyIncompleteReadOnly: The owner has not completed company setup yet.
profileIdentityHint: These details will appear on your invoices as the supplier.
profileBillingHint: Choose your VAT status and payment method. Payment terms will be adjustable on individual invoices.
profileAdvancedHint: Numbering, currency and time zone. You can keep the defaults.
navSoonHint: Grey items are coming soon. Profile settings are ready to use.
deleteProfileHint: The profile will be removed from all lists and become unavailable to every member. Audit history remains in the database. Restoring profiles in the app is not available yet. Type its name to confirm.
unsavedProfileHint: Switching profiles will discard your edits. Stay here to save them, or continue without saving.
accountIntro: Your personal details and sign-in. Applies to all your billing profiles.
accountPasswordHint: Leave these fields empty to keep your password. A new password must contain at least 12 characters.
accountSecurityHint: Confirm your email or password change. Other sessions will be signed out.
accountEmailTaken: This email is already used by another account.
accountConflict: Your account changed in the meantime. Close settings and reload the page.
accountDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
contactsIntro: Customers and contacts for this billing profile.
contactSearch: Search by name, registration number or email
contactEmptyHint: You can add contacts manually without connecting to external registries.
contactSearchHint: Try another name, registration number or email.
contactRecipientsHint: Separate email addresses with commas. No messages are sent yet.
contactPreferencesHint: An empty due period and default payment method inherit the billing profile settings.
contactInvalid: Check contact details, text lengths and email formats. A name is required.
contactConflict: The contact changed or the creation key was already used. Your edits have been preserved.
contactNotFound: The contact or billing profile does not exist, or you do not have access.
contactReadOnly: You have read-only access to this contact.
contactArchiveHint: Archiving preserves contact details and history. You can restore the contact from the archive later.
contactReloadHint: Reloading the current version will discard your unsaved changes.
aresFilled: ARES details added to empty fields. Review them before saving.
aresMissing: Registration number not found or profile inaccessible. You can enter details manually.
aresInvalid: Enter a valid eight-digit Czech registration number for ARES.
aresUnavailable: ARES is unavailable. Retry or enter the details manually.
aresHint: Leaving the registration number field fills empty fields from ARES. Your entries are preserved.
aresCountry: The ARES address country differs from your entry. Check the country and retry.
aresIntro: Enter a Czech registration number to look up the name, VAT number and registered address. Enter other details manually.
draftIntro: You can save an incomplete draft. The final invoice number and PDF are assigned when issued.
draftConflict: Someone changed this draft. Your edits have been preserved.
draftNotFound: Draft or profile not found, or you do not have access.
draftInvalid: Check the entered details and highlighted items.
draftCheckFields: Some values are invalid or exceed the allowed limits.
draftEditSupplier: Edit details on this document only
draftFindCustomer: Find a customer in the directory
draftCustomerSnapshot: This document holds a copy of the details. Edits here do not change the directory.
draftMaturityHint: Calendar days from the issue date. 0 = due on the issue date.
draftNumberError: Enter a valid number within the allowed range.
draftCalculationFailed: Total is not available yet. Complete the item numbers or check your connection. You can save an incomplete draft.
draftReadOnly: You have read-only access to this draft.
draftDiscard: Loading the server version will discard your unsaved edits.
draftListIntro: Invoices for the active billing profile.
draftEmptyHint: Start a new invoice or adjust your search.
issueConfirm: The invoice will receive its final number and its contents will be locked. It will not be sent to the customer automatically.
issueSaveFirst: Save the draft and review its details before issuing.
issueNumberPreview: Expected number: {{number}}. The final number is assigned when issued.
issueYearError: The numbering year in profile settings must match the issue date.
issueSequenceExhausted: This number series is exhausted. Set up a new series in the profile.
issueTaxModeError: Invoice VAT mode does not match the profile on the tax date. Check profile tax settings.
invoiceImmutable: This issued invoice is locked. Its details and PDF use the saved version.
invoicePdfError: Could not load the PDF. Try downloading again.
invoiceNonPayer: Supplier is not registered for VAT.
paymentAddHelp: Record the amount actually received. A higher payment is recorded as an overpayment. The invoice and PDF stay unchanged.
paymentReverseHelp: The original record and reason remain in the history. This corrects your records; it does not refund money to the customer.
paymentConflict: Payments have changed. Refresh the current balance, review the amount and confirm again.
paymentInvalid: Check the positive amount (up to 2 decimal places), a date between issue and today, and the correction reason. Zero-value invoices cannot receive payments.
overviewIntro: Receivables and manually recorded payments for the active billing profile.
overviewAsOf: As of {{date}} in the profile time zone.
overviewScope: All-time totals in CZK. Drafts and reversed payments are excluded from amounts. This overview is not a profit calculation or tax report.
paymentZero: A zero-value invoice does not require payment.
importHistorical: Historical import: values and amounts were preserved from the source. The original PDF was not transferred; retain it from the source application. Import does not change numbering for new invoices.
importIntro: Transfer customers and historical invoices into the active billing profile. Review the preview before confirming the import.
importAgendaHint: Use a stable account or workspace ID from the source. Reuse it for subsequent imports from the same account. Different accounts must have different IDs.
importGuideIdoklad: In iDoklad, open Address book → Contacts → Export and choose CSV or XLSX columns. Keep the original ID, registration number and country code. Always review the suggested mapping.
importGuideFaktura: In FakturaOnline, export contacts to XLSX. Keep the original ID, registration number and country code. If the export lacks stable IDs, add your own permanent identifiers. Always review the suggested mapping.
importGuideGeneric: Upload contacts as CSV/XLSX with column mapping. Complete historical invoices require conversion to our JSON format, including line items and original totals.
importFormats: UTF-8 CSV or XLSX: contacts, one sheet, header in the first row. JSON: contacts and complete CZK invoices following the template. Limit: 2 MB and 500 records. Store numbers with leading zeroes as text in Excel. Service presets have not yet been verified against real exports.
importMappingHint: ID, name and two-letter country code are required. The preview shows the first three rows. Unmapped columns are not transferred; use JSON for delivery addresses and contact people. Names never trigger automatic merging.
importChanged: A record with this source ID has different content. Existing data will not be overwritten.
importCollision: A matching contact or invoice number already exists in this profile. Skip the record or correct the source and prepare a new preview.
importDuplicateKey: This source ID appears more than once in the file.
importMissingContact: The referenced contact has not been transferred or is missing from this batch.
importCurrency: This currency is not supported yet; only CZK is currently accepted.
importPaymentDate: The payment date is in the future.
importInvalidField: A value is missing or does not match the supported format
importLimits: Invoices: complete standard domestic CZK invoices only, with 0/12/21% VAT, line items and original totals. A spreadsheet invoice list alone is insufficient. PDFs, attachments, advances and credit notes are not transferred. Retain originals and check numbering settings after import. Nothing is sent.
importBackup: Before importing, back up the target database and files using the installation guide. Automatic batch rollback is unavailable; bulk deletion could damage later changes and relationships.
importConfirm: I reviewed the target profile, mapping, skipped records and limitations, and have prepared a backup.
importProgress: Processed {{done}} of {{total}}. After an interruption, reopen this batch from history to continue.
importDone: Batch complete. Newly imported: {{count}}. Review the report, including skipped records.
importInvalidFile: Cannot read this file or data. Check the format, mapping, required values and limits. XLSX must have one sheet without formulas, macros or external links.
importConflict: This request conflicts with existing data. Refresh the batch and review its result before retrying.
draftManualCustomer: Enter customer manually / by registration number
invoiceFilterInvalid: Check the date and amount ranges. The start must not exceed the end.
draftPaymentsPending: Payments are available after issuing the invoice
contactSnapshotHint: Changes to this contact will not affect invoices already issued.
contactDiscardHint: Unsaved changes to this contact will be discarded.
catalogSearchHint: Try another name, catalog code or EAN.
catalogConflict: Someone else changed this item. Reload the current version.
catalogReloadHint: Reloading the current version discards unsaved changes.
catalogSearch: Search name, catalog code or EAN
catalogArchiveHint: Archived items will no longer be offered on new invoices. Existing invoices remain unchanged.
catalogEmptyHint: Add products and services to fill in invoices faster.
catalogReadOnly: You have read-only access to this profile.
catalogSnapshotHint: Price list changes do not affect items already saved on invoices.
catalogDiscardHint: Unsaved item changes will be discarded.
catalogLineFailed: Could not add this item. Try selecting it again.
salesInvalid: Check the name, customer, dates and items.
salesConflict: This record has changed or was already converted. Reload the current version.
salesNotFound: Record not found in this profile.
salesConvertHint: Creates a draft invoice for review. Issue it in the next step.
salesSentHint: The status tracks negotiations. Changing it does not send an email.
salesArchiveHint: The record remains saved and can be restored from the archive.
quoteMailHint: The quotation will be attached as a PDF. You can edit the message before sending.
quoteNoHistory: This quotation has not been emailed yet.
quoteSmtpMissing: Email is not configured. The operator must configure an SMTP server. PDF and printing are available.
quoteSentHint: Mail server acceptance does not confirm delivery or reading. If the result is unconfirmed, check the mail server before sending again.
quoteMailError: Could not prepare the email. Check the recipient and supplier email addresses or reload the current quotation.
quotePdfError: Could not prepare the PDF. Please try again.
quotePrintHint: Preview of the same downloadable PDF. Use the PDF viewer controls to print, or open the file in a new tab.
quoteOpenPdf: Open PDF in a new tab
quoteDefaultBody:
Hello,

Please find attached quotation {{number}} for {{name}}. This quotation is valid until {{date}}.

Thank you for your interest.
{{supplier}}
quoteQueuedNotice: The message is queued. Follow its progress in email history.
shareHint: Anyone with the link can see the current quotation and download its PDF. You can revoke the link at any time.
shareCopyFailed: Copy is unavailable. Select and copy the address from the field.
shareUnavailableConfig: The operator must configure the public application URL (PUBLIC_WEB_URL).
shareError: Could not complete the operation. Reload the document and try again.
shareTrackingHint: We record opening the preview, not reader identity or proof of reading. Repeated technical requests are not counted again.
shareNoActive: First create an active public link in the document details.
shareMailHint: The current quotation link will be appended to your message. No PDF will be attached.
shareDefaultBody:
Hello,

Here is a link to quotation {{number}} for {{name}}. This quotation is valid until {{date}}.

Thank you for your interest.
{{supplier}}
publicQuoteUnavailableHint: The link may have expired or been revoked. Contact the sender for the current quotation.
publicQuoteError: Could not load the quotation. Please try again.
publicQuoteTracking: Opening this preview is recorded in the quotation history for the sender.
shareRevokeHint: This link will also stop working in emails already sent.
publicQuoteDownloadedHint: Use the PDF viewer controls to print.
invoiceMailHint: We will attach the issued invoice PDF. Review the recipient and message before sending.
invoiceMailDefaultBody:
Hello,

Please find attached invoice {{number}} for {{name}}, with a total of {{amount}}. The due date is {{date}}. Payment details are included in the PDF.

Thank you.
{{supplier}}
invoiceNoHistory: This invoice has not been emailed yet.
invoiceMailError: Could not prepare the email. Check the recipient and supplier email addresses or retry the request.
mailFailureRejected: The mail server rejected the message. Check the recipient and mail configuration.
mailFailureUnknown: The mail server did not confirm the result. Check whether the message was sent before sending again.
mailFailureInterrupted: Processing was interrupted. Check the mail server before sending again.
mailFailureProfile: The invoicing profile is no longer available.
mailFailureLink: The public link is no longer valid.
mailFailureInvalid: Could not build the message. Check its details.
smtpDescription: Shared settings for the entire installation and all billing profiles. Only the installation administrator can manage them.
smtpEnvironmentHint: Uses SMTP configured by the server operator. Server credentials are not displayed here.
smtpDisabledHint: New emails cannot be sent. Queued messages wait until delivery is enabled again. An email already being sent may complete.
smtpPasswordSaved: A password is stored. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement. Clearing the username disables authentication and removes the password.
smtpPasswordHint: Required for SMTP authentication. The password is never displayed after saving.
smtpKeyMissing: The server encryption key is unavailable. To store a password, the operator must run init-secrets or configure SMTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE.
smtpSaved: Settings saved. They apply immediately to invoices and quotes.
smtpTestHint: Sends a separate message using the saved settings. Use your own address and check your inbox afterwards.
smtpSaveFirst: Save your settings before sending a test.
smtpTestSent: The mail server accepted the message. Check your inbox and spam folder; delivery is not confirmed.
smtpTestFailed: The mail server rejected the message. Check the server, security, credentials and sender.
smtpTestSending: This test is still running. Click again to check the same attempt without sending another email.
smtpTestUncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Check your inbox or SMTP logs before starting another test to avoid duplicates.
smtpError: Could not complete the settings change or test. Check the details and connection. Retrying the test uses the same attempt.
smtpConflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Close and reopen this dialog to load the current version.
smtpForbidden: Only the installation administrator can manage SMTP.
smtpRateLimit: Too many tests. Wait a minute and try again.
attachmentsHint: Choose or drop up to 5 files, each up to 2 MiB. PDF, PNG, JPG, ZIP, RAR, XLSX, DOCX, ODT, ODS or TXT.
attachmentsEmailHint: Select files to attach to this message. The public quote link does not expose them.
attachmentsSaveFirst: Save the document before adding attachments.
attachmentsSizeError: The file must be between 1 byte and 2 MiB.
attachmentsTypeError: The file format or content is not supported.
attachmentsCountError: A document can have at most 5 attachments.
attachmentsStorageError: This profile has reached the 256 MiB storage limit. Remove unneeded attachments; files kept in email history are retained.
attachmentsError: Could not complete the attachment operation. Refresh the list or retry the upload.
attachmentsDeleteConfirm: Remove attachment “{{name}}”? Existing emails and their history will retain it.
exportHint: Downloads all records matching the current filters and order, not just this page. Up to 10,000 records.
exportTextHint: XLSX stores values as text to preserve exact amounts and leading zeros. CSV uses semicolons and UTF-8; import its columns as text.
exportLimit: More than 10,000 records match. Narrow the filters and try again.
exportError: Could not download the export. Check your connection and try again.
advanceNotice: A proforma invoice is not a tax invoice. Issue a tax receipt from a payment, or settle a fully paid proforma into a final invoice.
advancePaymentHint: Records a received payment. No tax receipt or final invoice is created. Overpayments are allowed.
advanceLater: Proforma settlement will be available in P13-03.
taxIssueHelp: Review the VAT breakdown. Issuing creates an immutable document and blocks reversal of this payment. Nothing is sent.
taxAllocationHint: The payment is allocated proportionally across the original proforma VAT rates.
taxListHelp: Issue a tax receipt from the Payments tab of a VAT payer’s proforma invoice.
taxImmutable: Already paid — do not pay again. The issued document and its source payment are protected against changes.
taxLocked: A tax receipt exists for this payment; reversal is unavailable.
settlementStoredTax: Tax breakdowns come from issued tax receipts. Their amounts are not recalculated.
settlementHelp: Select fully paid proformas for the same customer. They will be reserved for this draft; issuing the invoice is a separate step. Deselect all to remove deductions and release reservations.
settlementEligibility: Requires a fully paid proforma without overpayment or another reservation.
settlementInvalid: Advances must be fully paid and share the customer and tax mode. Invoice dates cannot precede payments or tax receipts, and its price must cover deductions. Save any invoice changes and try again.
creditSourceHelp: A credit note corrects amounts. Setoff and money refunds are recorded separately.
creditListHelp: Create a credit note from an issued invoice. The original document is preserved.
creditSearch: Search credit note, invoice, customer or correction reason
creditLinesHelp: Enter a positive correction including VAT. Zero skips an item. Document rounding is credited proportionally. Save the draft to check available amounts and recalculate the breakdown.
creditSaveFirst: Save changes to recalculate and check available amounts.
creditIssueHelp: The issued credit note and its PDF become immutable. Nothing is sent or refunded.
creditCancelHelp: The draft will be cancelled and retained in history. The original invoice stays unchanged.
creditOffsetHelp: The entire remaining credit is set off against the original invoice balance. This is neither cash income nor a refund.
creditManualHelp: Record only a refund that has actually been made. The app does not initiate a bank transfer.
creditReverseHelp: The original entry stays in history with a reversal. This reopens the credit balance and, for setoff, the original invoice balance.
creditOpenPdf: Open PDF in a new tab
creditAdvanceHelp: You are correcting settled supply. Original advances, tax receipts and their links are preserved and cannot be reused.
creditInvalid: Check the amounts and remaining correction balance. The correction must be positive and cannot exceed the original supply; a refund cannot exceed the credit balance.
creditOffsetError: The original invoice has insufficient outstanding balance to offset the entire remaining credit.
creditDatesError: Provide a reason and check dates: issue from the original invoice date to today, tax correction between original supply and issue, and due date no earlier than issue.
recMonthEnd: Issue on the last day of the month
recScheduleInvalid: Check the dates, interval and time zone.
recAnchorLocked: After the first invoice the schedule anchor is fixed. Create a new template for a different interval.
recAutomationHelp: A saved template is paused. Activation starts the selected actions, including missed dates. The server must be running.
recAutoSend: Send email with PDF after issue
recMailBody: Hello, please find your invoice attached. Thank you.
recConfirm: Check the recipient, content and dates. Pausing does not cancel created invoices or queued emails.
recConfirmEmail: Invoices will be issued automatically and emailed to the specified recipient.
recConfirmIssue: Invoices will be issued automatically without sending emails.
recConfirmDraft: Each date creates a draft for review. Nothing is automatically issued or emailed.
recStopped: Generation stopped. Check permissions, invoice content, tax mode and numbering year in profile settings. Then reactivate; no duplicate invoice will be created.
recInvalid: Check required fields, items, payment details and schedule settings.
recHistoryHelp: Total invoices: {{count}}. Showing the latest 100; all are in the invoice register.
recMailError: Enqueue failed; check SMTP/permissions. Retrying within 5 minutes.
recListHelp: Templates for automatic invoicing. Pause an active template before editing.
recNumberingError: Check the numbering year and available number in profile settings. Then reactivate the template.
recTaxError: The template VAT mode differs from the profile on the invoice date. Correct the template or profile tax history and reactivate.
recPermissionError: The user who activated this template no longer has write access. A profile owner or editor must reactivate it.
communicationPause: Pause automatic emails for this invoice
communicationChanged: The message was not sent because payment, permissions or automation settings changed. Open a new preview and review the details.
communicationReminderUnavailable: A reminder can only be sent for an overdue invoice with an outstanding balance.
communicationThanksUnavailable: Thanks can be sent once the invoice is fully settled and includes a received payment.
communicationSettingsHelp: Automatic messages use the customer email saved on the issued invoice, the document language and a PDF attachment. Up to 10 reminders per invoice. You can edit the text before sending manually and pause automation in the invoice detail.
communicationFirstDays: First reminder: days after due date
communicationMinimum: Only invoices with a total above (CZK)
communicationThanksHelp: Applies to new manually recorded payments after enabling this option. One automatic thank-you per invoice; reversing a payment does not generate another. Bank matching is not connected yet. A credit-note offset alone does not trigger thanks.
communicationConflict: These settings were changed by someone else. Reload the current values and apply your changes again.
communicationConfirmHelp: Saving authorizes the server to email customers of this profile. Reminders include existing overdue invoices. Thanks apply only to new payments. Disabling stops queued messages; an email already sent cannot be recalled.
communicationAutomationError: An automatic message could not be queued. Check the customer email, payments and profile settings. You can send it manually after reviewing the preview.
attachmentsInvoiceEmailHint: Select the files you want to attach to this message.
invoiceShareHint: Anyone with this link can access the issued PDF and current payment status. Set an expiry and revoke it at any time. Custom attachments and payment history remain private.
publicInvoiceUnavailableHint: The link may have expired or been revoked. If the problem persists, ask the supplier for a new link.
publicInvoicePdfHint: This is the original issued PDF, including any advance settlement. Payment status reflects the last refresh. Download the PDF if your browser cannot display the preview.
invoiceShareMailHint: The invoice link will be appended to your message. No PDF will be attached.
publicInvoiceError: Could not load the invoice. Please try again.
publicInvoiceTracking: Opening this preview is recorded in the invoice history for the sender.
receivedAmountsHint: Enter the net amounts and exact VAT from the received document. The rate is recorded only; VAT is not recalculated. All amounts are in CZK.
receivedPaymentHint: Record an expense already paid, up to the outstanding amount. This action does not transfer money or create a bank instruction.
receivedReversalHint: The reason and original record remain in the history. Reversal does not change a completed bank transfer.
receivedConflict: The document changed or has active payments. Reload it; reverse payments before editing or cancelling the document.
receivedInvalid: Check the supplier, number, dates and amounts. Amounts allow up to two decimal places; a payment cannot exceed the outstanding amount.
receiptPaidHint: A receipt records an already paid purchase. Saving records full payment on the issue date. Bank and cash register matching is not available yet.
expenseInvalidPeriod: Check the period and filters. The start date must not be later than the end date.
expensePurchasesHint: Invoices and receipts by issue date, including VAT.
expensePaidHint: Active payments by payment date in the period.
expenseOverdueHint: Outstanding liabilities past their due date today.
expenseOverviewHint: Amounts are in CZK. This overview uses recorded documents and payments; it is not an accounting profit and loss statement or bank cash flow. Cancelled documents and reversed payments are excluded.
expenseEmpty: No payments match this period and filters.
bankAccountHelp: Accounts belong to this billing profile. IBAN cannot change after the first movement. This does not change the account on issued invoices.
bankNoAccounts: Add a bank account to import and record movements.
bankManualHelp: This records a movement only. An invoice payment is created after manual matching. Enter a positive amount.
bankImportHelp: Select an account, format and file. Review the transactions before importing. Import does not create payments.
bankImportInvalid: Correct invalid rows or ID conflicts in the file. No movements will be saved while it contains errors.
bankFailed: Bank data could not be loaded or saved. Please retry.
bankConflict: Data changed or a transaction ID was reused with different content. Refresh the page and review the data.
bankInvalid: Check the details: valid IBAN, date no later than today, non-zero amount with up to two decimal places, CZK currency and a variable symbol up to 10 digits. Imports must use the documented format.
bankCandidateHelp: Match income to invoices or advances, and expenses to received invoices, card-paid receipts or credit note refunds. Up to 50 documents of each type are shown; search by number or partner for more. Existing payments will not be duplicated.
bankCandidateSearch: Document number, partner or variable symbol
bankNoCandidates: No eligible documents. Check the direction, date, amount and outstanding balance.
bankArchivedHelp: Restore the archived account before matching.
bankExistingPayment: Linked to a previously recorded payment.
bankMatchNewHelp: The full movement amount will be recorded as a new bank payment of the selected document. Nothing is sent to the bank.
bankMatchExistingHelp: The movement will link to the selected existing payment. The paid amount of the document will not change.
bankUnmatchCreated: Unmatching reverses the payment created by this match. The document balance will become outstanding again. The bank movement is retained.
bankUnmatchExisting: Only the link will be removed. The previously recorded payment will remain.
bankLinkedPayment: This payment is linked to a bank movement. Unmatch it in Bank first.
bankNativeHelp: Based on published specifications; real exports are still being verified. Always use the same format for each account.
bankWrongAccount: The statement account does not match the selected bank account. Check the IBAN.
bankMixedFormat: This account already has an import in another format. Use the previous format to avoid duplicate transactions.
bankStatementInvalid: This statement variant cannot be safely imported. Check the format, original filename, CZK currency and transaction IDs. Batch entries and unknown payment directions are unsupported. Nothing was imported.
bankSuggestionsNone: No eligible match by variable symbol and amount. You can search for a document manually.
bankSuggestionsUnique: One match found. Check the document and payment before confirming.
bankSuggestionsAmbiguous: Multiple possible matches. Select the correct document; nothing is matched automatically.
bankSuggestionsFailed: Could not load suggestions. Search manually or reload the page.
bankCamtHelp: CZK statements: Air Bank business accounts, George Business, ČSOB CEB, KB and UniCredit.
bankFioHelp: Fio JSON statement with transaction IDs. No API key connection is needed.
bankMonetaHelp: MONETA XML statement. Entries without an explicit credit or debit direction cannot be imported.
bankRbHelp: ABO external account format. Keep the original filename ending in _CZK.gpc.
bankBatchHelp: Only unmatched transactions on the current page and within its filters, up to 25. Confirming applies exact, unambiguous matches only. Skipped transactions remain for manual review.
bankBatchCompeting: Another transaction has the same symbol and amount
bankBatchShared: Multiple transactions target the same document
bankBatchTooMany: Too many documents with the same symbol
bankBatchStale: Data changed since the preview. Nothing in this batch was applied. Refresh and review the preview.
bankBatchEmpty: No match is eligible for batch confirmation. Review transactions individually in their details.
cashAccountHelp: A CZK cash register. The opening balance and date cannot change after the first voucher.
cashNoAccounts: Create a cash register and enter its opening balance first.
cashManualHelp: Record a cash receipt or expense. A saved voucher can be cancelled with a reason.
cashFailed: Cash register data could not be loaded or saved. Please try again.
cashConflict: Data changed or a transaction ID was reused with different content. Refresh the page and review the data.
cashInvalid: Check the amount, required fields and date. The date must be between the register opening date and today.
cashEmpty: No cash vouchers match these filters.
cashCandidateHelp: Match income to invoices or advances, and expenses to received invoices or credit note refunds. Existing cash payments must have the same amount and date and will not be duplicated.
cashCandidateSearch: Document number, partner or variable symbol
cashNoCandidates: No eligible documents. Check the direction, date, amount and outstanding balance.
cashArchivedHelp: This register is archived. Restore it before matching new payments.
cashExistingPayment: Linked to a previously recorded payment.
cashMatchNewHelp: A cash payment for this amount will be created for the document.
cashMatchExistingHelp: The movement will link to the selected existing payment. The paid amount of the document will not change.
cashUnmatchCreated: Unlinking reverses the payment created by this match. The invoice becomes outstanding again. The cash voucher remains in the register.
cashUnmatchExisting: Only the link will be removed. The previously recorded payment will remain.
cashLinkedPayment: This payment is linked to a cash voucher. Unlink it in Cash register first.
cashCancelHelp: The voucher stays in history but no longer contributes to the cash balance. Enter a reason.
cashBalanceHelp: This register summary includes all non-cancelled vouchers in the period, independently of the list filters.
cashAutomationHelp: Choose the main cash register for new cash payments of invoices and purchase receipts. Earlier payments are not imported. Correcting a payment also updates its cash record.
cashAutomaticSource: This voucher was created automatically from a cash payment. Correct or reverse the payment on its source document; the cash record will update with it.
cashDefaultArchived: Change the main cash register or disable automatic vouchers first.
cashAutomaticDate: The cash payment date must fall within the main register period and cannot be in the future. The payment was not saved.
cashPdfError: The PDF could not be prepared. Please try again.
cashTaxHelp: A standalone item cannot be matched to an invoice. Its breakdown is saved on the voucher and PDF; tax returns are not yet available.
cashTaxPayer: Standalone VAT items are only available to VAT payer profiles.
cashTaxInvalidDate: The tax point date must fall within VAT registration, no later than the movement date, and cannot be in the future.
cashTaxInvalidAmount: Enter a non-zero price with at most two decimal places (up to CZK 1 billion) and a VAT rate of 0, 12 or 21%.
cashTaxDescription: Enter a name or description for the standalone item.
cashTaxNoMatch: A standalone VAT item cannot be matched to another document.
bankBalanceHelp: Totals include all recorded movements in the period, regardless of pagination or matching. This is not a verified live bank balance.
bankBalanceError: The period is invalid or the balance cannot be loaded. Dates cannot precede the opening balance.
bankOpeningMissing: No opening balance is configured. Income and expenses are available; the closing balance cannot yet be determined.
bankOpeningHelp: Enter the balance at the start of the selected day. Earlier movements remain recorded but are excluded from this balance. The change and its reason are audited.
connectionHelp: Connect using your own credentials. Synchronization retrieves the last 30 days; import statements for older data. Automatic matching is enabled separately. Available providers depend on your installation.
connectionSecretHelp: Saved tokens are never displayed. Leave blank to keep the token for the same provider. Never enter your online banking password here.
connectionFioHelp: Create a read-only API token for this account in Fio online banking. New tokens may take several minutes to become available.
connectionGatewayHelp: Use the token for a provider configured by your installation administrator. It must implement the Open Faktura bridge protocol; this is not a universal bank login.
connectionConfigured: Credentials saved — verify with a test
connectionDisconnectHelp: Disconnecting removes the saved token. Imported transactions and their matches are preserved. Separately enabled automatic matching will continue; disable it using its own switch.
connectionLoadError: Could not load the connection status.
connectionActionError: Could not complete the operation. Check the input and server encryption key configuration. Refresh the status before retrying.
connectionConflict: The settings changed or another operation is running. Refresh the status.
connectionNetwork: The provider is unavailable or returned an error. Try again later.
connectionAuth: The provider denied access. Check token validity and permissions.
connectionRate: The provider rate limit was reached. Wait before trying again.
connectionFormat: The response does not match the supported format, account, currency or period. No transactions were imported.
connectionAccount: The response belongs to another bank account. No transactions were imported.
connectionImportConflict: The import contains conflicting transactions. No transactions were imported.
connectionInterrupted: The operation did not finish within its time limit. Refresh the status and try again.
connectionAutoHelp: The first run starts after the selected interval. It uses your permissions and does not match payments. Changing credentials disables automation.
connectionAutoPermission: Automation was disabled: the account, profile or activating user’s permissions are no longer available. Enable it again after resolving the issue.
connectionAutoBusy: The scheduled run skipped a concurrent operation. It will retry at the next interval.
connectionAutoSetup: The scheduled run could not start. Check credentials and the server encryption key configuration.
matchingHelp: Matches only unambiguous variable symbols and exact amounts. Creates a payment or links an existing one; uncertain movements remain for manual review. Also works with imported statements without a bank connection. Manually unlinked payments are not matched again.
matchingPermission: Matching was disabled because the account, profile or permissions are unavailable. Enable it again after resolving the issue.
matchingFailed: The batch could not be processed. None of its payments were saved. The next attempt is in five minutes.
bankSplitHelp: Select documents and amounts. Existing payments are linked in full without creating another payment. Any surplus remains unallocated. The entire batch is saved together.
bankSplitInvalid: Check amounts: they must be positive with at most two decimal places and their total must not exceed the movement remainder. Select each document only once per batch (up to 25).
bankUnmatchAllHelp: All active links on this movement will be removed. Payments created by matching will be reversed; previously recorded payments will be preserved. Enter a reason.
terminalHelp: Identify a sales location or device for sales receipts. This does not connect a payment terminal to a bank.
retailEmpty: No sales receipts match the filter.
retailPaymentHelp: Cash, card and voucher payments must add up to the total exactly. Record an already received payment.
retailConflict: The document or terminal has changed. Load the latest version before another change.
retailInvalid: Check the items, date and payment total. VAT payer sales receipts are limited to CZK 10,000.
retailPostingHelp: Select receipts in the table. Cash creates a cash register document; card and voucher payments are stored in an internal breakdown. The latest 100 batches are shown.
retailPostingFailed: Posting failed. Check the date, cash register and current receipt status.
inboxIntro: Upload PDF, image or ISDOC files (up to 2 MB). The original is preserved. Review and complete the data before creating a received invoice.
inboxFailed: The operation failed. Check the file type and size or reload the current state.
inboxReview: The inbox original will be attached on save. Review all fields; supported ISDOC files can be prefilled.
inboxExtractFailed: This document cannot be read by the supported ISDOC parser. Enter the data manually; the original is preserved.
inboxHistoryDescription: Record of original document receipt and processing.
stockIntro: Opening stock, manual and document receipts and issues, physical counts and traceable corrections.
stockCountHelp: Enter the physical quantity. The difference against the current revision is recorded today.
stockMoveHelp: Positive for receipts, negative for issues. Up to four decimal places, using a decimal point.
stockFailed: The operation failed. Check the quantity, date and current item revision.
appearanceFailed: Could not load or save appearance.
reportScope: Document values in CZK. Invoices use the tax date (issue date for non-payers), purchase invoices the receipt date, and receipts the issue date. This is not cash flow or profit; advances are not counted twice.
reportError: Could not load the report. Choose a period of at most 367 days and try again.
reportMonthlyHint: Totals of all documents in the selected period. Exact amounts are also available in the chart table.
reportCumulativeHint: Running total from the start of the selected period. Empty months retain the previous value.
stockStatHelp: Totals include all pages. Adjustments include opening entries, stock counts and reversals; these are separate from regular receipts and issues.
stockInvoiceLink: Catalog item: issuing deducts stock if inventory tracking is enabled.
stockValuationHelp: Stock as of the selected date. Valuation uses a manually entered CZK stock cost per unit, not the sales price list. This is not automatic FIFO or weighted-average acquisition costing.
stockValuationFailed: Could not load the report or save the cost. Check the date, cost and current revision.
stockPartialValue: The total is incomplete: it includes only valued stock. Missing costs and negative balances remain unvalued.
stockCostHistoryHelp: An empty cost means unknown value. Backdated costs recalculate reports from their effective date. History shows the latest 100 changes.
stockAcquisitionHelp: Base acquisition unit cost including non-deductible VAT. Do not also include incidental costs entered below. Up to 4 decimals; blank = unknown cost.
stockAutomaticHelp: Moving average including price corrections and returns at original issue cost. Price changes are compared with the first receipt. Unknown inputs and negative stock are not estimated.
stockAcquisitionCorrection: Acquisition input correction; its effect is included in the valuation recalculation.
stockIncidentalHelp: Allocated by acquisition value across stock lines, which must have known costs. Does not increase the supplier payable; do not also include these costs in unit prices.
invoiceRegisterIntro: Issued documents, payments and invoice drafts.
overviewTurnoverScope: Document values including VAT; not cash flow or profit.
overviewReportUnavailable: Sales and purchase overview could not be loaded.
overviewInvoicesUnavailable: Recent invoices could not be loaded.
invoiceIssueHint: Issuing assigns a number and locks the content. It does not send the invoice.
